data.description:
## Context / Problem

`src/rebar/_mcp_health.py:103-789` aggregates startup handshake, instrumentation, health routing, request lifecycle, transport, and shutdown at 789 lines. The maintainer approved only the cohesive handshake extraction, not a broader lifecycle redesign.

## Approach

Move the existing startup-handshake call-graph cluster into one focused sibling module. Keep `_mcp_health` as the compatibility and orchestration facade and retain its existing handshake exports. This buys module headroom while minimizing operational behavior change.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/_mcp_health.py`
- new focused handshake sibling under `src/rebar/`
- `src/rebar/mcp_server.py` only if import wiring requires it
- MCP startup/health tests

Cascade flag: true. Recensus semantic, string, dynamic import, and monkeypatch references before moving symbols.

## Testing

Preserve successful and failed startup handshakes, signer binding, route readiness, offload/instrumentation ordering, and shutdown/transport behavior through the existing focused suites.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Only the cohesive startup-handshake cluster is extracted and `_mcp_health` remains the lifecycle/orchestration facade.
- [ ] Existing handshake symbols and public/dynamic patch targets continue resolving through `_mcp_health`.
- [ ] `wire_health` ordering, health routes, signer binding, instrumentation/offload, SIGTERM, transport, and shutdown behavior are unchanged.
- [ ] MCP startup-handshake and health-store suites plus module-size and complexity gates pass.
data.title: Extract only the MCP startup-handshake call-graph unit
